description: This file contains the implementation of TwitterClientMessageHandler, a custom HTTP message handler for OAuth authentication with Twitter API, including methods for generating OAuth signatures and nonces.

classes.name: TwitterClientMessageHandler
classes.description: A custom DelegatingHandler for managing OAuth authentication when sending HTTP requests to Twitter API.

methods.name: GetNonce
methods.description: Generates a unique nonce string based on current UTC ticks.

methods.name: ConfigureOAuthAsync
methods.description: Configures OAuth headers for the HTTP request, including signature generation and token protection.
